title: SRD 5.1 importer: rule-text + action + table parsers
description: Add parsers for the general-rule-text sections of the SRD 5.1 (kind=rule), the standard action entries (kind=action, e.g. Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, Use an Object), and the freestanding reference tables (kind=table, e.g. exhaustion levels, encounter difficulty, treasure tables). The rule kind has a 'text' required field; the table kind has required 'columns' and 'rows'.
acceptance_criteria:
- rule parser extracts each labeled rule section from the SRD core rules chapters.
- action parser extracts each named standard action.
- table parser extracts the freestanding reference tables with column headers and rows.
- All records satisfy their kindSchemas (rule.text, table.columns/rows).
- Manifest description includes 'rule, action, table' in Included record kinds.
close_reason: Split into three separate parsers for shippable scope: loreweaver-0m9.5.10 (rule-text), loreweaver-0m9.5.11 (action), loreweaver-0m9.5.12 (reference-table). Each is one session of work; the original bundled all three.
